test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If two-fifth of three-eighth of one-sixth of a certain number is 52, what is 40% of the number?
solution:
**Given:**

Two-fifth of three-eighth of one-sixth of a certain number is 52

**Solution:**

Let the number be x

According to the question,

(2/5)(3/8)(1/6)x = 52

⇒ x = 52 × 40

⇒ x = 2080

40% of the number

⇒ 40 × 2080/100

⇒ 832

**∴ The correct answer is 832.**
